description: Idealized STAR-like double-null target for topology-safe fitting. This is not a solved equilibrium and should not be treated as a CAD-final constraint.

coil_regularization.notes: The fit script should strongly discourage CS-dominated improvement. CS may be allowed, but not as the primary shape actuator.

stage_3.name: full but regularized local refine
stage_3.notes: Only run if topology remains clean and CS does not dominate.
